blurb: We bring the intensity of Sebastien Lagree's workout to our six locations in Marina Del Rey, Culver City, Playa Vista, Manhattan Beach and Redondo. The Lagree Fitness workout is a total-body program that combines elements of cardio training and weight-bearing activity to create a revolutionary, one-of-a-kind exercise program.
